Meta.title: Overlap
Meta.description: Meet the people your campus life already overlaps with.

Home.title: Overlap
Home.tagline: Meet the people your campus life already overlaps with.
Home.whatBody: We introduce you to people based on campus life you actually overlap with — the same class, the same club, similar free time. Not just a photo to swipe past, but a reason you'd get along.
Home.whyBody: Instead of endless swiping, we introduce 6 carefully picked people every day at noon. Each one comes with the reasons you overlap, so you can find people who actually share your interests, faster.
Home.safetyBody: Only verified students can be matched with, and you can block or report anyone at any time. When it's time to meet, we suggest public spots on campus.
Home.statusNote: We're still building this. Join the waitlist and we'll email you the moment we open.
